content: keytap 0.4.0 (Apr 2026) is purpose-built to replace rdev: CGEventTap without the Sonoma-crashing layout APIs, typed PermissionDenied via IOHIDCheckAccess, Drop-based shutdown, plus a chord feature for hotkey matching; rdev is unmaintained since 2023. Workspace already uses keytap 0.4: keep it and use its ChordMatcher for hotkey-annotate instead of adding a hotkey crate.
